description: PAID (price varies by route, $0.001-$0.05) — the generic way to call ANY route in the Utility Grid. Pass the route path and a JSON body matching its input schema (use get_endpoint_spec first if unsure). Handles the full x402 payment flow automatically: fetches the 402 challenge, signs a USDC payment on Base, retries, and returns the result. Requires WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.

body.description: JSON body matching the route's input schema (see get_endpoint_spec)

name: call_endpoint
